pilot_signal.receiver_gauge: reference primary coefficient of independent pilot; TX/RX global phase unresolved

diagnostics.band_rule: pilot spectral peak width and active-duration resolution, disjoint at midpoints
diagnostics.feature_covariance_rule: independent-repeat covariance plus AR(1)-inflated sample-noise floor; 3 repeats are rank deficient
diagnostics.receiver_phase_identifiability: relative to independent pilot only; absolute TX/RX split unavailable
diagnostics.FID_sign_convention: exported Re+iIm fitted as exp(+2pi*i*f*t); sign of physical Mxy precession not independently verified
diagnostics.frequency_fit_uncertainty_scope: conditional independent-sample Hessian; do not use as calibrated coverage
diagnostics.likelihood_covariance_scope: repeat variation plus measured phase/return model discrepancy; systematic bias remains separately checked

diagnostics.profile_variance_rule: max(complex fit residual, repeated same-width pilot scatter)
diagnostics.projection_scope: linear signed pilot-frozen mode, defined at Rabi nulls

rabi.scope: complex FID mode amplitude versus pulse width; t90=period/4 under sinusoidal calibration model

model.physical_scope: validated short H pulse effective one-spin response with frozen measured multiplet

model_validation.response_check_scope: repeat FIDs contributed to the pilot signal and Rabi fits; phase FIDs were not used for receiver-gain fitting; response checks choose detection sign
model_validation.pulse_detuning_origin_scope: model convention, not independently measured RF carrier offset
model_validation.fid_frequency_source: complex FID; no unverified Ramsey delay submitted
model_validation.response_check_threshold_rule: measured feature signal >= 3x per-feature noise and complex RMSE <= min(0.5x signal, max(4x noise, capped coherent-fit allowance))
model_validation.receiver_gauge: fixed independent pilot coefficient; only relative phase inferable

short_fid_validation.criterion: same frozen complex FID feature/frequency; at least 5 percent measured whole-cycle saving

particle_convergence.criterion: adjacent N posterior means within 0.35 frozen tolerance in identifiable coordinates

tolerance_basis.tolerance_rule: pilot repeat scatter and Rabi profile; frozen before A-E; reference must independently resolve it
tolerance_basis.prior_scope: fid frequency shift, t90 at 100 percent RF, circular phase relative to pilot gauge

frequency_mechanism: complex FID fit and frozen feature likelihood
comparison_scope: effective single-H-spin short-pulse response; not multi-qubit gate fidelity
